scenes.caption: SchoolSync AI: upload a school calendar PDF (synthetic, fictional school)
Set school, academic year and timezone

Legend read from the PDF itself: colours are matched to its labels,
nothing is hard-coded (no 'red = holiday')

One cell uses a colour that is NOT in the legend:
flagged for review, not guessed

Each event shows duration, category, source page and status;
uncertainty is explicit, not a single score

Half day with NO printed time: the app will not assume noon.
Confirm is blocked
You supply the dismissal time; the edit is logged in history
Colour-only cell with no text: needs a title and duration from you
Resolved by a person, with source evidence kept
Month-calendar view of the same events
Confirm the legend mapping before export or sync
Import history: first import of this school and year

ICS downloaded: all-day events are date values,
timed events carry a timezone, stable UIDs

Preview: 8 creates, nothing written yet.
Sync needs your explicit confirmation of this exact plan

Report: 8 created in the in-memory demo calendar
(no real calendar is touched)

Run it again: 8 skipped, 0 created.
Duplicate-safe: already synced, unchanged
